svg.text: shinchan_calibrate_offset.aesl: line, two squares and three circles drawn by the pen behind the centre hole
Blue: what the pen draws on the calibrated robot. Grey: robot at the start, facing up, with the pen 4.5 cm straight behind the centre hole. Dotted: path of the robot's centre.
Pale box: paper needed so the wheels stay on it (robot body sweep + 2 cm). The pen starts at the red dot, robot facing up.
paper 32 × 21 cm; pen start 9 cm from the left, 7 cm from the bottom
paper 41 × 46 cm; pen start 20 cm from the left, 20 cm from the bottom
paper 41 × 30 cm; pen start 11 cm from the left, 14 cm from the bottom
